title: Implement provider-native tool calling for Ollama and GitHub Models with fallback
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 2.2. Current tool invocation relies on text JSON extraction only. Add provider-native structured tool calling for providers that support it, preserve current text parsing as fallback, and include compatibility tests to prevent regression for legacy models.
